chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from 'Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, who said:
I asked Aba Ja'far عليه السلام about the minimum in which a woman may perform salat (prayer). He said: a shift and a wrap, which she spreads over her head and with which she covers herself.

key_terms.أَدْنَى: the minimum or least required amount
key_terms.دِرْعٌ: a long shirt or shift worn as a garment
key_terms.مِلْحَفَةٌ: a wrap or outer covering cloth

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum clothing required for a woman to perform salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith states the minimum clothing in which a woman may perform salat (prayer). Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام specifies that she should wear a dır' and a milhafah that she places over her head and uses to cover herself.
